Aggregate Platform-Specific Probes

Source: R/MethQcSet-methods.R
aggregate_probes-MethQcSet-method.Rd

Apply platform-specific probe aggregation. Currently supports EPICv2 aggregation (multiple measurements per base CpG to single representative value).

Usage

# S4 method for class 'MethQcSet'
aggregate_probes(x, method = c("median", "mean"), ...)

Arguments

x

A MethQcSet object.

method

Character, aggregation method ("median" or "mean"). Default: "median".

...

Additional arguments (reserved for future use).

Value

A MethQcSet object with:

  • Updated beta slot (aggregated if platform=="EPICv2", unchanged otherwise)

  • Updated detection_pval slot (if present)

  • Updated aggregation_status slot

  • An aggregation report in qc_tables(x)$Aggregation_report

If platform is not "EPICv2", returns object unchanged with message.

Details

For EPICv2 data, this method calls aggregate_beta_epicv2() to consolidate multiple probe measurements (e.g., cg06373096_TC11, cg06373096_TC12) into a single value per base probe ID (cg06373096). This is essential before merging EPICv2 data with EPICv1 or 450K cohorts.

The aggregation report (columns metric, n, description) counts the replicate groups collapsed, identifiers kept unchanged, malformed identifiers (kept or removed) and values missing because all replicates were missing; see aggregate_beta_epicv2(). A one-line summary is also printed as a message.
